|strategy=By [mailto:vanfleet@bucknell.edu Jim Van Fleet], RED 15<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020803212054/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/revolution.html</ref>

[[Revolution]]. Its what the Rebel Alliance is all about! This Effect from the Premiere Edition has endured, and even grown in popularity through all the game expansions.

Many players find it an indispensable tool in the battle to overthrow the Empire. A list of the benefits of [[Revolution]]: 1) it can be deployed on any location (except the [[Death Star]]) 2) it Revolves (switches) not only the game text, but also the Force icons at that location, 3) although it is not cumulative, there is no limit to how many [[Revolution]] cards can be in play.

When the Premiere Edition stood alone, [[Revolution]] was used most often as a way to increase Light Side Force drains. Played on [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut]], it created an easy Force drain of 3. This strategy is still prevalent, but now many players rely on [[Revolution]] at [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut]] to create a Force drain that is difficult to counter.

Equally important is the strategy of using [[Revolution]] to take away game text and Force icons from the Dark Side. Deploying a couple of Revolutions early in the game can cripple Dark Side ground-based decks such as [[Walker Garrison]] or [[Tatooine]] drain, by denying them both Force generation and Force drain bonuses.

[[Revolution]] has a destiny of 3, pretty average, and a fairly high deploy cost of 3. The main drawbacks of this card are the new cards that Decipher has created, which specifically counteract the powerful effects of [[Revolution]]. The Light Side player must be prepared with multiple [[Sense]] and [[Control]] cards to defend [[Revolution]] against [[Evader]] or [[Surprise]] , and may find it impossible to counter the very popular [[Imperial Decree]]. On a positive note, [[Revolution]] is not cancelled by [[Imperial Decree]], just "ignored." Late in a game, if the Light Side prevails and the conditions for [[Imperial Decree]] cannot be met, the Dark Side will suffer the effects of [[Revolution]] again!

Card Combos:

[[Revolution]] + any Hut for a significant Force drain bonus.

[[Revolution]] versus the [[Tatooine: Jundland Wastes]] + Expand the Empire card combo: Make the Dark Side regret using this popular Force drain strategy. [[Revolution]] is one of the few cards that can make a Dark Side Effect work for the Light Side.
